biological_interpretation: Calcineurin-subunit loss in thalamic neurons is captured by a small synaptic/calcium and endocytic-countermodule rather than by an NFAT/RCAN transcript reporter.
caveats: The AP-2 link is an anticorrelation from restricted signature vectors, not a double-perturbation or pathway epistasis test.
NFAT localization and calcineurin phosphatase activity were not measured, and Nfatc3 perturbation itself was under-engaged.
exact_observed_result: Ppp3ca and Ppp3r1 were both FDR-depleted in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut and produced compact but nonidentical calcineurin-subunit signatures. Ppp3ca increased Pcsk1n, Ptpn3, Iyd and Pik3r1, whereas Ppp3r1 increased Pcsk1n/Ptprs and lowered Atp2a2, Coro6, Slc6a17, Tle2 and Ndrg2; AP-2 adaptor perturbations were the strongest anticorrelated Ppp3r1 neighbors in this same signature space.

prior_expectation.summary: Prior work supports the broad molecular function of the perturbed target or complex, while the atlas result refines the affected brain cell type and RNA-output module.

resolved_evidence.description: Across-cell-type measurement of Ppp3ca transcript engagement; the strongest FDR-confirmed target reductions were in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, 155 MB Glut, 005 L4-5 IT CTX Glut, and 007 L2-3 IT CTX Glut.
resolved_evidence.statistics: Ppp3ca perturbation was assayed in 22/23 cell classes with 26-240 perturbed cells per class; Ppp3ca logFC was negative in all 22 classes; target transcript nominal p<0.001 in 14/22 and FDR<0.05 in 4/22.

resolved_evidence.description: The thalamic Prkcd/Grin2c glutamatergic class had the strongest non-target transcriptional response to Ppp3ca knockdown.
resolved_evidence.statistics: 240 perturbed cells versus 23679 controls; Ppp3ca logFC -0.483 FDR 6.35e-12; Iyd logFC -1.085 FDR 0.0112; Ptpn3 logFC -0.224 FDR 0.0239; Pik3r1 logFC 0.488 FDR 0.0239; Pcsk1n logFC 0.285 FDR 0.0507; Etnk1 logFC -0.123 FDR 0.0698; Per1 logFC -0.275 FDR 0.106.

resolved_evidence.description: Large on-target repression in midbrain glutamatergic neurons produced a much smaller downstream expression signature than the thalamic class.
resolved_evidence.statistics: 220 perturbed cells versus 20353 controls; Ppp3ca logFC -0.715 FDR 2.11e-11; zero non-target genes at FDR<0.05; Pcsk1n was the strongest non-target hit, logFC 0.278, nominal p=1.33e-05, FDR 0.116.

resolved_evidence.description: Layer 4/5 IT cortical neurons showed clear Ppp3ca engagement but only one FDR<0.05 non-target gene.
resolved_evidence.statistics: 155 perturbed cells versus 15039 controls; Ppp3ca logFC -0.511 FDR 2.38e-06; Zbtb11 logFC 0.566 FDR 0.0190; Plekhg5 logFC -0.387 FDR 0.218.

resolved_evidence.description: Upper-layer cortical Ppp3ca engagement reached FDR but downstream genes remained subthreshold.
resolved_evidence.statistics: 85 perturbed cells versus 7553 controls; Ppp3ca logFC -0.393 FDR 0.0182; zero non-target genes at FDR<0.05; Gpd1 logFC -0.906 FDR 0.164 and Fut9 logFC 0.558 FDR 0.384 were the strongest non-target genes.

resolved_evidence.description: The FDR-level downstream response was concentrated in one thalamic glutamatergic cell type.
resolved_evidence.statistics: 11 total Ppp3r1 rows had pvals_adj<0.05: 9 in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, Ppp3r1 only in 059 CNU-LGE LSX GABA, and Ppp3r1 only in 155 MB Glut; the other 16 tested cell types had zero FDR-significant rows.

resolved_evidence.description: Strongest non-target Ppp3r1 response module in the dataset.
resolved_evidence.statistics: 93 perturbed cells versus 23,679 controls. Ppp3r1 logFC -0.703, score -5.917, FDR 1.89e-5; Pcsk1n +0.710, score 6.771, FDR 2.21e-7; Ptprs +0.356, score 6.553, FDR 4.87e-7; Atp2a2 -0.327, score -5.623, FDR 8.08e-5; Coro6 -0.472, score -5.226, FDR 5.99e-4; Tle2 +0.913, FDR 0.0271; Ndrg2 +0.616, FDR 0.0298; Septin4 -0.614, FDR 0.0313; Slc6a17 -0.286, FDR 0.0496.

resolved_evidence.description: The top anti-correlated perturbation neighbors reversed several of the Ppp3r1 151-cell-type FDR genes.
resolved_evidence.statistics: Across all 17,259 scored genes in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, the strongest negative Pearson signature neighbors of Ppp3r1 were Ap2s1 r=-0.2555, Ap2m1 r=-0.1586, and Pten r=-0.1209. In Ap2s1-perturbed cells, Atp2a2 was increased, logFC 0.355, FDR 1.14e-22; Slc6a17 increased, logFC 0.205, FDR 2.85e-7; Ptprs decreased, logFC -0.345, FDR 8.43e-22; Ndrg2 decreased, logFC -0.905, FDR 2.40e-22; and Tle2 decreased, logFC -0.908, FDR 2.79e-7.

resolved_evidence.description: Ppp3ca knockdown did not produce a detectable transcriptional change in NFAT transcripts or the canonical calcineurin-feedback RCAN genes.
resolved_evidence.statistics: Across 22 Ppp3ca cell classes, all assayed Nfat-family rows and Rcan1/2/3 rows had FDR=1.0; the best nominal values were Nfatc2 p=0.0346, Nfat5 p=0.00343, Rcan1 p=0.192, Rcan2 p=0.0848, and Rcan3 p=0.0159.

resolved_evidence.description: Calcineurin catalytic and regulatory subunit perturbations engaged their transcripts and produced significant thalamic signatures that were not correlated with Nfatc3.
resolved_evidence.statistics: Nfatc3: 172 perturbed cells, no FDR<0.05 genes and target logFC -0.028, FDR=1.0. Ppp3ca: 240 cells, 4 FDR<0.05 genes, target logFC -0.483, FDR=6.35e-12. Ppp3r1: 93 cells, 9 FDR<0.05 genes, target logFC -0.703, FDR=1.89e-05. Pearson correlations between the Nfatc3 score vector and Ppp3ca or Ppp3r1 vectors across 17259 genes were -0.003 and 0.0349.

resolved_evidence.description: Midbrain glutamatergic cells showed robust mRNA-level engagement of calcineurin subunits but not of Nfatc3, and no transcriptome-scale similarity between these signatures.
resolved_evidence.statistics: Nfatc3: 157 perturbed cells, no FDR<0.05 genes and target logFC -0.299, FDR=1.0. Ppp3ca: 220 cells, target logFC -0.715, FDR=2.11e-11. Ppp3r1: 73 cells, target logFC -0.965, FDR=4.62e-07. Pearson correlations between the Nfatc3 score vector and Ppp3ca or Ppp3r1 vectors across 17443 genes were -0.0017 and 0.0009.

title: Ppp3ca and Ppp3r1 loss expose a noncanonical thalamic calcineurin module
